== Introduction ==

edited by Chuck Kallenbach II

Comments: Michael's Dark Side finals deck was the most unusual single deck of the tournament. Particularly interesting was his use of A Dangerous Time to rearrange Phillip's Force pile. This card, combined with Defensive Fire, Scanning Crew and Voyeur, made for several nasty combinations that surely frustrated his opponent. While Michael did win the final game with this deck, the Force differential was not enough to offset Phillip's masterful first game victory.
